line: Every photo you've ever taken has already been looked at by AI — without you ever asking it to.
It can find the best photo from any trip you've ever taken.
By default, your questions can be reviewed to help improve the feature.
One setting keeps those questions between just you and the AI.
It won't undo the AI's own learning so far — only who sees your questions.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
